reason: The inspected revision makes recovery substantially more intelligible: applicants can compare changed fields, download both copies and explicitly combine answers; final submission validates its receipt or reconciles the owned cycle before clearing recovery. Close grading now distinguishes unknown acknowledgement from rejection, preserves a same-tab pending marker and requires authoritative closed status. The original submission/closure objections are addressed in this local scope. The mobile recovery capture is readable and deliberate, and the public proposition states cost and semester duration immediately. Canonical release diagnostics distinguish persisted forms from qualifying locked evidence and explain closed-round escalation honestly. However, Group Case saving still has an unbounded pending path that can strand later evidence writes. That material recovery defect prevents unqualified world-class agreement. Missing approved engagement proof, workload facts and hosted acceptance further limit the broad assessment; polished captures and passing synthetic checks cannot substitute for those results.

findings.evidence: save() awaits the previous per-applicant promise at line 149, then calls authorizedFetch through retryOnNetworkError at 157-161 and consumes response.json at 162 without any deadline. finish() releases the queue only in finally at 178-179. Neither helper bounds a nonsettling request/body. Saving feedback at 338 therefore can persist indefinitely; the recovery controls at 420-423 depend on error/hint state, and another save still waits behind the stalled promise. The inspected failed-save browser case supplies an immediate 409 rather than stalled transport/body. This is source-derived, not an observed hosted failure.
findings.userImpact: A reviewer can keep adding observations while every subsequent save for that applicant remains blocked. Reloading to escape risks losing those in-memory notes and ratings.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound authorization, request and full-body consumption; preserve the exact observations and expose an explicit unconfirmed state with private export/reconciliation guidance. Protect ordering against a delayed original write before sending newer payloads. Add focused stalled-headers and stalled-body cases verifying bounded feedback, retained evidence and safe queue recovery.

notVerified: Actual Clerk/Supabase/RLS/storage/email integration, hosted submission reconciliation and consequential operator recovery; no staging exists.

Real authenticated sequential keyboard journeys, screen-reader use, physical iPhone or macOS Safari, and observed human comprehension/task success. Supplied private captures and browser APIs are synthetic.
Approved real engagement artifacts and current Board-confirmed workload facts remain absent; retention, original-resume/blind-review policy and closed-round remediation authority remain unresolved.

No tests were executed for this review. Recorded Node, SQL and browser evidence establishes its documented local scope; inspected logs do not establish an uninterrupted all-browser pass or production readiness.
